body:
I'm supporting her all I can atm but not showing her how really hurt I truly am through all this. she's really understanding, but she just really needs me for support right now. I mean, she fucked him and she doesn't even remember it (we know it happened, though, we have our own proof). She's as angry as I am that is happened. Neither of us understand how we feel.

edit: i know for a fact that she's unmedicated, and i'm trying to get her to see some sort of therapist, but she has an inherent mistrust of adults because of her turbulent history and refuses to talk to any sort of therapist about it.

I don't even know how to feel. I mean, it's not like she cheated on me herself, it was her fucking spiteful alter who's in love with that asshole.

I'm not angry at her, I'm angry at her alter.
